Tent Rentals in Antigonish, Nova Scotia

Tent rentals for Antigonish events are available from Nova Kingdom Rentals — from Highland Games season to campus and church events. Our 10x10 Pop-Up Canopy Tent rents for $175, with an optional $50 for our team to handle setup and takedown; weight bags come included. Our 10x20 Pole Tent rents for $275, with an optional $75 for setup and takedown, and covers a complete seating or dining area on a stakeable grass surface. These are open-sided shade canopies rather than enclosed event tents, they must stay anchored at all times, and they are never used in high winds, storms, or unsafe weather.

We serve northern and central Nova Scotia including Antigonish. Travel from Bridgewater is $0.72/km after the first free 15 km and is quoted up front. Availability, setup suitability, and final pricing are confirmed manually before any booking.

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does tent rental cost in Antigonish?
The 10x10 Pop-Up Canopy Tent is $175 to rent, plus an optional $50 for setup and takedown. The 10x20 Pole Tent is $275 to rent, plus an optional $75 for setup and takedown. Delivery is quoted separately. Travel from Bridgewater is $0.72/km after the first free 15 km and is confirmed in your quote. Final pricing for Antigonish is confirmed manually.
Do you deliver tents to Antigonish?
Yes. Travel from Bridgewater is $0.72/km after the first free 15 km and is confirmed in your quote. Delivery, setup suitability, and availability for Antigonish are confirmed manually before booking.
What surface do the tents need?
The 10x10 pop-up comes with weight bags and suits most flat, clear areas. The 10x20 pole tent uses stakes and guy ropes, so it needs a stakeable grass surface with clear space around the perimeter. Neither tent can be used in high winds, storms, or unsafe weather, and both must stay anchored at all times.
Can I add tables and chairs to a tent rental in Antigonish?
Yes. Black padded folding chairs are $3 each and 6 ft tables start at $8 each. Add them to any Antigonish tent booking, or combine tents with inflatables, lawn games, and the 360 Video Booth.
